notes.title: V1.0.0 - Optional removal of flies
notes.content:
For players disgusted by presence of flies on levels, if you press (and hold) keys: F, L, Y in that exact order while playing any level, it will remove all the flies as if they're found already.

NOTE: This will reduce playtime by 50% as half the objects will now already be found. 

See here:
https://steamcommunity.com/app/2346140/discussions/0/3878218563605149331/

[h3]CHANGELOG[/h3]
ADDED - FLY command
